notes: §1985:XV.3.2.3 SR5: "Procedure-names defined within debugging sections must not appear within USE FOR DEBUGGING statements." FinalizeDebug resolves each bare or qualified operand through ResolveDebugProcedure, and AddNamedDebugSubject refuses (COBOL6946) a procedure whose section IsDebugging before recording any subject. The witness names a paragraph of another debugging section. Probes at --std 85: another debugging section's name, the section's own paragraph, its own section-name and a qualified D1-P OF D1 all refuse; ALL REFERENCES OF a debugging paragraph refuses as a non-data operand (COBOL5848); paragraphs and the section-name of a USE AFTER ERROR section are legal subjects and fire before the USE procedure after a failed OPEN. Read 6 (2026-11-14, records-read6): the row had no verdict and no test-ref although its witness existed; the reader read CONFORMS and an independent refuter UPHELD it (op-20261114/out-read6/rd-NN.json and rd-NN-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "Procedure-names defined within debugging sections must not appear within USE FOR DEBUGGING statements."; 2023: "No USE FOR DEBUGGING format: the 2023 USE rules cover only AFTER EXCEPTION, BEFORE REPORTING, EC and EO.". The 2023 USE candidates cover only exception, reporting, EC and EO forms. None has the DEBUGGING phrase, and no clause holds the Debug module, so the feature and its rule are dropped.
